demo.title: Demo controls
demo.description: Plays out situations without putting the plant at risk: the device reacts for real (pump, light bar, buzzer), and the pump's safety limits still apply.

demo.waiting: Waiting for the device's next message (every ~15 s)
demo.inactive: No demo running – all values are real measurements.

dry.title: Dry soil

tankLow.title: Tank almost empty
tankLow.effect: Tank at 4 % → buzzer beeps, automatic watering stops
tankLow.hint: Then press “Tank refilled” – the device remembers the fill level.

sensorFail.title: Sensor failure
sensorFail.effect: Temperature and humidity sensor stop responding

night.title: Night
night.effect: Light at 2 % – as if it were dark

demo.startMessage: “{{label}}” started – the device will pick it up with its next message.
demo.stopMessage: Demo stopped – real values will return with the next message.
demo.commandMessage: “{{label}}” will be sent to the device with its next message.

water.soilDry: The soil is dry ({{pct}} %). You can water it right now.
water.soilOk: The soil is nicely moist ({{pct}} %). No watering needed right now.
water.soilWet: The soil is already very wet ({{pct}} %). Only water if you are sure.
water.soilUnknown: Soil moisture is unknown right now. You can still water.

water.amountHintNoMl: One press = one short burst of water ({{s}} s).
